data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'kinz', meaning 'moon'. In Islamic tradition, the moon is a symbol of constant change and growth. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kenza usually hope their child will grow to embody moon, bright star and live with faith, good character and purpose.
